baseline.shared_feature_policy: original indexed Float32 vertex IDs only; no coordinate welding

method.candidate_scope: all faces incident to any candidate vertex whose packed Float32 xyz differs bytewise from baseline; each selected face is tested against the complete surface
method.comparison_baseline: same 013v2 emitted Float32 candidate for all rows
method.face_identity: dense physical_outer_faces row IDs preserved unchanged
method.incremental_owner: _update_complete_self_pair_baseline; unchanged-pair reuse only when both complete exact triangle records and source IDs are identical
method.interpretation: negative baseline-to-candidate normal cosine is diagnostic only; exact self-crossing classification comes from owner315 triangle intersections
